06

Color & usage

Ink#101922
Paper#FAFAFC
Amber#FFC72C
Orange#FF7800
Vermilion#F23D0B

Preserve the identity

Keep OpenTag casing, the tag silhouette, the punched hole, and the five audio bars. Preserve aspect ratios and clear space.

Choose the right format

Use SVG for interfaces and flexible layouts. Use the supplied PNGs for upload forms, social images, and raster-only applications.

Keep it readable

Use the flat or monochrome version for small icons. Use the dark-surface wordmark on dark backgrounds and the ink version on light backgrounds.
